packageRules.description: ESLint v10 is not compatible with the current frontend lint setup. Keep ESLint packages on v9 until the config is migrated.

The ruamel.yaml.clib pin that first blocked 3.14 is gone and no runtime dependency declares a 3.14 incompatibility, but the image is only ever exercised on 3.13 (CI python-version, pyproject target-version). Move those to 3.14 first, then drop this rule.
